title: In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 465 of the Acts of 1980 the Department of Public Utilities makes an assessment on the following Gas and Electric companies to provide the Conservation fund of the Department with the amount of $88,793.53 adjusted for the excess of the FY1997 estimate over the amount expended and to restore the Fund to its previous balance for the 1998 Fiscal Year.
filings: ORDER Supplementary Order Commissioners: Howe, Patrone, 97-64CA
Order Issued. Residential Conservation Assessment for Fiscal year 1998. Commissioners: Howe, Besser 97-64C DPU
